name: Panasonic KX-TG6813 DECT Triple
short_description: In stock in store at 29 Church St, Dundalk. Photo to be confirmed.
description: The Panasonic KX-TG6813 is a premium DECT cordless phone (triple handset set) with a dedicated Call Blocker to stop nuisance numbers, Noise Reduction for clearer calls and a bright 1.8-inch backlit display. Power-failure talk keeps you connected in a blackout, and it supports up to six handsets.
features: Dedicated Call Blocker for nuisance calls
